headline: T T Limited announces a change in its board of directors
hook: Leadership shift at a listed textile maker
summary: T T Limited has formally notified the stock exchange about a change in its board of directors. The filing pertains to routine corporate governance and management restructuring at the company. No financial impact or strategic shift was detailed in the brief disclosure. Retail investors should note this is standard administrative churn unless it involves key executive personnel.
why_it_matters: Routine board changes have negligible impact on your holdings.

headline: T T Limited shares insider trading disclosure with the exchange
summary: T T Limited has submitted a disclosure under Regulation 7(2) of SEBI's Prohibition of Insider Trading Regulations, 2015. Such filings detail transactions by promoters, directors, or designated persons in company shares. Retail investors should note this is a routine compliance filing rather than a major operational event.
why_it_matters: Routine promoter transaction disclosure with no immediate share price impact.
